No guarantee: each library picks which apps it pays for, so check yours. Library cards are usually free for local residents. AI answers can be wrong, so confirm on your library's website.

Stop overpaying for car insurance. Three ways to pay less 🚗
how to lower car insurance: raise your deductible and the discounts to ask for

1. Open Google and tap AI Mode (it answered me without signing in)
2. Type: "how to lower my car insurance bill what discounts should I ask for"
3. Ask your insurer what a $1,000 deductible would cost vs your $500 one. Only do it if you have $1,000 saved for a claim
4. Ask for: bundling (with home or renters), paying in full, and paperless + autopay
5. Compare the same coverage and deductibles with at least 3 insurers

No guarantee: discounts and prices depend on your insurer, state and driving record, and a higher deductible means you pay more if you file a claim. AI can make mistakes, so get a real quote before you change anything. This isn't insurance advice.

items.caption:
Don't call the police yet. Your missing package may show up tomorrow 📦
package says delivered but not here or stolen: what to do (wait 24 hours, seller, claim, police report)

1. Open Google and tap AI Mode (it answered me without signing in)
2. Type: "my package says delivered but it was stolen what should I do"
3. Check around your door and with neighbors, then wait 24 hours. Carriers sometimes scan "delivered" up to a day early
4. Still gone? Check the drop-off photo in tracking, and tell the seller quickly. Many have policies to replace or refund it
5. Then file a claim with the carrier, and a non-emergency police report if your card or insurance needs one

No guarantee: each seller and carrier has its own rules, so report it fast. AI can make mistakes, so check the carrier's own help page. Use only the official site or app; fake "delivery problem" texts are a common scam.
